title: Inclusion of Persons with Mental Health Conditions in Special Employment Credit and Open Door Programmes
what_it_is: Inclusion of Persons with Mental Health Conditions in Special Employment Credit and Open Door Programmes

sections.label: Mental health employment support programmes
sections.summary: Asks whether mental health conditions are covered by the Special Employment Credit and Open Door programmes, and whether legislative interventions on work stress are considered.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether persons with mental health conditions will be included in the Special Employment Credit and Open Door programmes and, if so, when; and (b) given that the Workplace Safety and Health Institute's Research Agenda for Singapore 2018-2020 listed "work stress" as one of its priorities under long-term challenges alongside "ageing workforce and technology", whether the Ministry is considering legislative interventions for risk assessments and counter-measures in the area of physical and mental health.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These are unlike mental health conditions which can improve or be managed with appropriate interventions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We recognise that some jobseekers with mental health conditions, such as depression and anxiety disorders, may also require employment assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They can approach the Job Club under the Institute of Mental Health (IMH) for job preparation and matching services, while managing their conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They can also tap on the range of programmes and services under the Adapt and Grow Initiative.

sections.label: Tripartite preference for promotional approach
sections.summary: States that while legislation is necessary for employment protection, tripartite partners prefer a promotional approach for more progressive workplaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While legislation is necessary to ensure employment protection, the tripartite partners prefer a promotional approach to bring about more progressive workplaces.

sections.label: SEC and ODP coverage criteria
sections.summary: Asks what stops the SEC and ODP from including mental health conditions, noting they cover medically certified conditions like autism spectrum disorder.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Can I just ask what is actually stopping us from using the SEC and ODP to include persons with mental health conditions?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, the SEC and ODP cover all persons that have been medically certified to have, for example, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), compared to, say, stress-related disorder which is considered a developmental impairment under the Enabling Masterplan.

sections.label: Support for employers of mental health conditions
sections.summary: Asks whether support similar to SEC and ODP exists for employers hiring persons with mental health conditions, who face the highest unemployment rate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
sentences.text: So, I am wondering if there is any support, very similar to SEC and ODP, for employers who want to take the journey in employing more persons with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
sentences.text: We understand that amongst the differently-abled groups in Singapore, persons with mental health conditions actually face the highest unemployment rate.

sections.label: Job Club run by IMH
sections.summary: Says the Job Club, run by IMH in partnership with the Government, exists because their conditions need help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Certainly, I am mindful that their conditions do need a bit of help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Therefore, we have the Job Club, for example, that IMH runs, together in partnership with the Government.
